name: Julien Agro Infratech Limited
about: Julien Agro Infratech Limited engages in the trading of agricultural products in India. The company provides land development, construction, and other related services for civil and structural construction, and infrastructure sector projects. It serves Indian Agricultural and construction sectors. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Silverpoint Infratech Limited and changed its name to Julien Agro Infratech Limited in August 2023. Julien Agro Infratech Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kolkata, India.
